candidates.name: Styled Layer Descriptor
verified_facts: SLD extends WMS so users can define symbolization and coloring of geographic feature and coverage data.
SLD controls visual portrayal and legend behavior rather than source measurement semantics.
semantic_limits: A styled layer or legend must not be treated as evidence of parcel geometry quality, terrain value precision or vertical accuracy.

candidates.name: Symbology Encoding
verified_facts: Symbology Encoding is an XML language for styling Feature and Coverage data.
It provides reusable portrayal rules independent of WMS-specific transport.
semantic_limits: A valid style expression changes presentation, not the underlying source accuracy, DTM lineage, datum or numeric elevation uncertainty.
